correctness.rationale: The positive-definite grounded matrix is the grounded unit clique B plus (w-1)bb^T, b=e1-e2. With v_i=c on leaders and a otherwise, the inverse of B is diag(v)+vv^T/[q(a-c)], since 1-sum(v)=q(a-c)>0. Its trace depends only on q. A second update gives J=J_clique+(1-w)s/[1-(1-w)r] with r=b^TB^-1b and s=||B^-1b||^2. The cases j=0,2 give 2a or 2c for r and 2a^2 or 2c^2 for s; the mixed case follows by squaring ce1-ae2-v/q. In particular r<=2/n<1 so the weakening denominators are positive. Under weakening j=2 has strictly smaller r,s than its competitors; q=1 excludes that count, gives equal r for j=0,1, and wins at j=0 by smaller s. Reinforcement maximizes s/(1+ur), u=w-1>0. Its j=1 versus j=2 numerator has positive constant and linear coefficients: the latter is 2c[a(a-c)(1+1/q)+a^2 n/q^2], establishing strict dominance whenever both counts are feasible. The j=1 versus j=0 numerator is exactly D+uH, with a positive denominator. The feasible endpoint counts give the stated q=1, n-1, n and interior cases, ties included, while w=1 gives full symmetry. Independently computed inverse traces via principal minors divided by determinant for all ten K5 three-leader sets at each of 11/10, 27/22 and 2. In order of j=0,1,2 the traces at equality are 49/60, 49/60, 212/255; the unique minimizing counts on the two test sides are 0 and 1 respectively.
residual_risks: The direct evaluation checks only the stated witness; universality follows from the rank-one argument. Assumes positive gains and conductances and a single exceptional link.

value.rationale: A single weighted link is a natural symmetry-breaking case in otherwise exchangeable finite-gain consensus. The theorem solves design rather than just evaluating a placement: it proves a budget-dependent change under weakening and a sharp switch with a tie under reinforcement. The K5 witness demonstrates that choosing by endpoint status alone, without the weight, is inadequate even in this minimal perturbation setting.
residual_risks: No extension to several modified links, heterogeneous gains or sparse ambient graphs is implied.
